images.title: Sorting by 2, 5 and 10
images.purpose: Show six numbers sorted into three overlapping circles: 16 and 48 divisible by 2 only, 35 and 85 by 5 only, 60 and 70 by 2, 5 and 10, and nothing in the part for 10 only.
images.composition: Three overlapping circles for divisible by 2, 5 and 10, two number cards in each of three regions and the word none in the part for 10 only.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three overlapping circles, each radius 190 px, 3 px dark #2B2B2B outline, with 35 percent opaque fills: circle A (divisible by 2) centred at (590, 330), amber #E69F00; circle B (divisible by 5) centred at (830, 330), teal #0072B2; circle C (divisible by 10) centred at (710, 538), reddish purple #CC79A7. The circles meet in 7 regions: the middle where all three overlap, the part of A only, of B only, of C only, and the three parts where exactly two circles overlap. Circle names outside the circles in bold dark #1F2937 (40 px): divisible by 2 centred at x 420 and y 100, divisible by 5 centred at x 1000 and y 100, divisible by 10 centred at x 710 and y 775. Exactly 6 number cards (rounded rectangles 100 by 56 px, white with a dark outline, bold number 40 px): in the part of A only, 16 at (500, 300) and 48 at (500, 380); in the part of B only, 35 at (920, 300) and 85 at (920, 380); in the middle where all three overlap, 60 at (710, 370) and 70 at (710, 432). In the part of C only, centred at (710, 640), the word none (40 px, bold, dark). The three parts where exactly two circles overlap are empty. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number divisible by 10 is divisible by 2 and by 5, so no number is divisible by 10 only.
images.description: Three overlapping circles for divisible by 2, by 5 and by 10 with 16 and 48, 35 and 85, and 60 and 70 sorted into them, and none in the part for 10 only.
images.context: Concept image for Divisible by 2, 5 and 10. It follows the idea of the three circles in your maths book (numbers sorted by 2, 5 and 10) and uses this concept's own example numbers.
images.teaching_notes: Test each number with 2, then 5, then 10 before placing it. The slip to watch is expecting a number for the part for 10 only.

image_decisions.why: The three circles show at once why the part for 10 only stays empty: every number in the circle for 10 is also in the other two.
